added_failures_note: baseline_suite (da4c4eb98) failure_ids are the five new reader tests failing on the base rule; after_suite (78ed4ac03) failure_ids are empty, so no failure present at the head is absent at the base and the added failure count is zero.

findings.text: follow-on: the near-fold persistence gate is unguarded — removing or weakening the level_enclosure comparison leaves all five reader tests green, so done_when (1)'s low-persistence exclusion can regress silently; only the jt-direct.json probe, which is outside the suite, exercises it. The negative control restores the first-root rule and reddens four tests, none of which reach this branch.

follow-on: the multi-axis retention (other_axes gathered after the saddles and marked valid) is covered by no suite test; its only verification is the one-off census_synthetic.py probe kept in the run directory rather than the repository, so a regression in the gather would not redden any gate.

follow-on: no poloidal flux-contour figure landed although docs/figures/converged-forward-solve/axis-ranking was a declared write path and the project mandate requires GS forward-solve evidence records to carry contour panels with both null sets and the vessel drawn; the 180-cell stress read that the island argument rests on is reported only in prose.

follow-on: the recorded after-suite arms run at revision 78ed4ac03 while the reviewed head is 4f1f4f55f; the three interposed commits are docs-only so the gate still measures the landed code, but the manifest's after_suite.revision does not equal the promoted head and a reader comparing the pair must resolve that gap themselves.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit from da4c4eb98 to 4f1f4f55f; 192bfbb27 adds the ranking and census multi-axis retention, 78ed4ac03 adds the persistence enclosure, the remaining seven commits are docs, and no file outside the declared scope is touched.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names reader tests plus TCV, field-swap and carrier measurements; the gate ran the three named test files in both arms (baseline-suite.log, after-suite-final.log) and the diagnostic receipts are recorded, but the 550/2000-cell carriers and coarse-window map states are explicitly unmeasured.
item_verdicts.goal: the goal is that read() ranks the census's valid in-vessel polarity extrema by sigma*psi and refuses invalid or wrong-type roots; scripts/prototypes/fast_map_production/kernel.py:241-288 at head implements exactly that, and the TCV receipts show seven wrong-type axes becoming refusals.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; status complete; it records baseline 5 failed/15 passed, after 20 passed/0 added, the first-head HDF5 open failure re-run clean, and blockers naming the unmeasured carriers.
item_verdicts.write_paths: read the manifest's declared paths; all five files in the diff (kernel.py, census.py, test_axis_ranking.py, docs/research/axis-ranking.html, docs/evidence/fragments/converged-forward-solve/axis-ranking.html) are inside them, and the declared figures path carries no file.

justifications.durability: negative-control-final.log shows four of five tests redden when axis = roots.position[0] is restored, but the persistence branch at kernel.py:278 and the census retention at census.py:167 have no assertion that fails on their removal.
justifications.evidence: baseline-suite.log and after-suite-final.log carry the revision, imported module path and a completed summary (5 failed/15 passed vs 0 failed/20 passed), and tcv-final.jsonl records ROWS 12/EXIT=0.
justifications.fit: the added block follows the surrounding jnp/vmap style of read() at kernel.py:241 and introduces no name outside the repository's conventions.
justifications.goal_fidelity: kernel.py:244-288 ranks the valid in-vessel polarity extrema and kernel.py:462 makes valid depend on axis_live, matching the goal, but the done_when's 550/2000-cell carrier and coarse-window identity clause is unmeasured.
justifications.reuse: read() reuses psi_rounding_enclosure (kernel.py:201) and topology._inside_cells (nova/equilibrium/topology.py:2568), census.py:167 extends the existing gather owner, and no new definition forks a capability; the closest production analogue, forward_operator.py:1612, is distinct spline machinery.
justifications.scope_discipline: all five changed paths in the diff (kernel.py, census.py, test_axis_ranking.py, docs/research/axis-ranking.html, docs/evidence/fragments/converged-forward-solve/axis-ranking.html) are inside the declared write paths.
